## Why

Three schedulers existed on paper (ADR-016's reserved Dagster, ADR-076's
GitHub Actions cron — disabled at P34.4 after failing 6 of 6, the de-facto
Cloud Scheduler fleet) and nothing compared `ops/cadence.toml` against
GCP. SIG-OPS-005 requires one scheduler of record plus a daily read-only
reconciliation; SIG-SEC-008 requires digest pinning with *declared*
exceptions. Live evidence (read-only, this row): 81 triggers / 82 jobs /
2 services / 4 buckets checked.

## What ships

- **`ops/cadence.toml` (the scheduler of record, additive schema)** —
  `[[maintenance]]` (the monthly `pg-logical-export` trigger, declared
  `state = "paused"` and inert until D-P34.6-2's verbatim go),
  `[live_diff]` (the daily `sig-sched-live-diff` trigger → `sig-probe`
  with a container-args override), `[[manual_jobs]]` (sig-export /
  sig-materialize / sig-replay-ingest — the only way to be legitimately
  untriggered), `[[pins]]` (declared holds off the fleet digest, each with
  `reason` + `expiry`, live-read digests for the manual jobs and both
  services), `[fleet]` (image repo + the committed roll record),
  `[[buckets]]` (declared public/UBLA/versioning/lifecycle posture), and
  `cron_or_semantics_ok` annotations on the three known dom⊕dow offenders
  (recorded exceptions queued for P35.1b, not endorsements).
- **`ops/src/ops/scheduled.py`** — dataclasses for the new tables and a
  `parse_cadence_doc` seam that splits TOML parsing from file I/O, so a
  GCS-published cadence loads in-image without an image roll.
- **`ops/src/ops/live_diff.py` (new, ~1,200 lines)** — the read-only
  reconciler: cron syntax + OR-semantics lint, cadence-vs-fire-count
  sampling, expected-state builders (triggers, jobs, services, pins,
  buckets), live fetchers (gcloud/REST) plus a `--from-state` fixture mode
  and a `--declared` bundle reader (`SIG_OPS_DECLARED_GCS`), real Cloud
  Scheduler `jobs:run` POST-body override normalisation, Cloud Run v1
  service shape and `valueFrom.secretKeyRef` secret bindings, and a
  `sig.live-diff/1` run row written under `ops/runs/_live-diff/` (WORM
  convention). Exit `0` clean / `1` drift / `2` error — fail-closed.
- **`sig-ops live-diff` + `cadence --check` lint** (`ops/src/ops/cli.py`)
  — `--live`, `--from-state`, `--declared`, `--cadence`, `--project`,
  `--region`, `--gcs-bucket`, `--alert` (the ADR-077 recorded-alert seam),
  `--emit-declared`; `cadence --check` now fails on the cron lint and pin
  schema too.
- **`ops/gcp/scheduled-ops.sh`** — reconciles the maintenance triggers
  (created then held at their declared `state` — a paused row is never
  enabled by the reconcile), deploys the live-diff trigger as a
  `--message-body` `overrides.containerOverrides[].args` POST body, stamps
  `SIG_OPS_CADENCE_SHA256` + `SIG_OPS_DECLARED_GCS` on every job,
  publishes the declaration bundle to `ops/declared/live-diff.json` on the
  restricted bucket, and *reports* (never deletes) undeclared live
  triggers — deletion is P35.1b's call. `--check` stays a no-network,
  no-ADC plan; `--apply` is the only mutation path and fails closed.
- **`ops/iam_identities.toml`** — `sig-probe-rt` gains only the read
  surface live-diff needs: `roles/run.viewer` +
  `roles/cloudscheduler.viewer` at project level and
  `roles/storage.legacyBucketReader` per declared bucket (the managed
  least-privilege fit — a custom role was considered and rejected in
  ADR-174).
- **`docs/adr/ADR-174-…` (new)** + appended `Qualified by ADR-174` status
  lines on ADR-016 and ADR-076; the ADR index, spec Appendix F row,
  backlog home (BL-085), and the ADR_TRIGGERS register row are all landed.
- **`tests/ops/test_live_diff.py` (30 tests)** — cron lint accept/reject,
  annotated exceptions, cadence-vs-fire-count, pin schema + expiry,
  `[[manual_jobs]]` matching, trigger/job/service/secret/bucket
  normalisers, DRIFT output and exit codes, fixture/state mode — all
  offline. The IAM contract tests were extended (not loosened) for the two
  new viewer grants and the new bucket legs.

## Live-read evidence (the honest baseline)

`sig-ops live-diff --live --project zeta-medley-508121-u7 --region
us-central1` at 2026-10-10, **exit 1 — real drift, exactly what the
mechanism exists to record** (28 findings):

- `schedule`: `sig-sched-live-diff` + `sig-sched-pg-logical-export`
  declared but not yet deployed (the queued mutation leg creates them);
  `sig-sched-sam-gov` live cron `0 5 1 * 1` vs declared `0 5 * * 1`.
- `job_config`: six live jobs neither cadence-owned nor `[[manual_jobs]]`
  — the four egress probes, `sig-ingest-resume-test`, `sig-sink-bench`
  (P35.1b owns the dispositions; the report names them, never hides them).
- `image`: eight ingest jobs on `sha256:63b809b2…`/`d1f943610f…` vs the
  declared roll digest `6ad5477d…` (a real, recorded spread).
- `public_posture`/`ubla`/`versioning`/`lifecycle`: the four buckets'
  live posture vs the declared target (sig-web's allUsers read is the
  D-P34.3-1-queued flip; UBLA/versioning/lifecycle are P35.1b/deferral
  legs).

No fetch errors; ADC present and read-only throughout. The production
reconcile (`scheduled-ops.sh --apply` + first in-band live-diff run) is
queued for the next AR-3 window with AR-2 prestate capture first.
